command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/mpl
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=8
cd /tmp
sha256sum -c repro-pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: a staged input does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
python3 -u hgb_repro.py covtype.data.gz > hgb-repro.log 2>&1
RC=$?
cat hgb-repro.log
test "$RC" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: the reproduction failed"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'HGB REPRO OK' hgb-repro.log || { echo "FAIL: no completion sentinel"; exit 1; }
uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo DONE
